question: Can the actual Gaussian compiler J act on the retained source time, charge, cocycle and uncompensated quarter transition, either in one fixed source frame or covariantly across its twist orbit?
scope: Exact affine fixed-sector obstruction and phase-corrected order-four covariance in the already stipulated even E8 lattice Fock representation. The entire tuple delta, q and quarter-transition cocharacter is transported. This is not a derivation of physical twist sectors, source selection or switching dynamics.
summary_de: Das tatsächliche J kann die feste Quellenzeit K nicht durch einen affinen Gitterlift erhalten: notwendig wäre 2δ in Ls, was exakt scheitert. Auch das feste Q bleibt nicht erhalten. Positiv existiert im vorausgesetzten E8-Fockraum ein unitärer Z4-Lift mit dem tatsächlichen geordneten CAR/E8-Cocycle. Er transportiert Kδ, Qq und die vollständige unkompensierte Vierteltransition gemeinsam entlang δa=J^aδ, qa=J^aq. Spektrum, Nichtnegativität und Grundzustandsdegeneration bleiben äquivalent. Die vier Rahmen sind vorerst eine Kovarianzfamilie, keine abgeleiteten physischen Sektoren oder Ereignisraten.
summary_en: The actual J cannot preserve the fixed source K through an affine lattice lift: it would require 2δ in Ls, which fails exactly. Fixed Q is not preserved either. Positively, the stipulated E8 Fock representation admits a unitary order-four lift using the actual ordered CAR/E8 cocycle. It transports Kδ, Qq and the full uncompensated quarter transition together along δa=J^aδ, qa=J^aq. Spectrum, nonnegativity and ground degeneracy remain equivalent. The four frames are a covariance family, not derived physical sectors or event rates.
assumptions: Already stipulated unitary even E8 lattice Fock representation M(1) tensor C_eps[Ls], with the existing ordered source CAR/E8 cocycle; no derivation from P1/P2.
The original folded source K(p,N)=|p|^2/2+delta.p+N, delta_k=(k+alpha)/8-1/2, source charge q=(1,...,1), and the retained orientation/physical-time scaling.
The actual J from v634, its original integral E8 basis, and the explicitly stated basis-generator lift convention.
Covariance transports q_a=J^a q and the complete uncompensated transition cocharacter; the original fixed charge is not secretly held unchanged.
The prior all-lattice nonnegativity/ground theorem and the conditional normal Cartan Ward-state rule keep their original representation and domain assumptions.
positive_results: Actual source cocycle yields U_J^4=I on the entire stipulated Fock representation: the all-charge extension argument reduces the fourth-power character to its +1 values on the eight original lattice generators.
K_(Jdelta) U_J=U_J K_delta, Q_(Jq) U_J=U_J Q_q and full uncompensated t_(Jtau) U_J=U_J t_tau; no quarter phase is deleted.
For both original quarter cases, delta has a four-element J orbit with J^2delta=-delta. All source spectra, positivity, domains and the twofold ground degeneracy transport unitarily.

The lift fixes the common vacuum vector. The already existing full Cartan Ward rule selects its density within the specified normal ground-doublet class; no new vacuum selection from G31 symmetry is asserted.
kills: Any fixed-K affine lattice action Ap+r with A^2=-I would imply 2delta in Ls; adjacent coordinate differences exclude that within the stated source class.
Keeping the original q fixed while claiming J covariance of Q.
Replacing the full uncompensated quarter transition with a compensated periodic clock or its adjoint shadow.
Interpreting a covariance orbit or direct-sum bookkeeping as a physical sector-switch process.
leaves_open: Select the E8 completion and its physical field/locality map from the primitive source; this representation is given here.
Determine whether the transported marked tuples are physically admissible frame descriptions or actual sectors, and derive any physical transition/instrument law.
Relate the even E8 source action to raw Xi, odd vector CAR/defect fields and the native interacting fields with their state/time action.
Full common-source selection and all physical T1-T8 gates.
not_claimed: No complete TFPT solution, raw-P1/P2 derivation, physical sector weight or switching rate.
No fixed-sector [K_delta,U_J]=0 or fixed-q charge symmetry.
No unique Hamiltonian ground eigenspace, source-selected lift character or universal quantum computation.
No new Lean build, verification-suite run, ledger or paper promotion.
